seoul-jongno.name: Jongno-gu
seoul-jongno.hours: Residential areas and back streets: 19:00–21:00 / Main roads: 22:00–01:00 (next day)
seoul-jongno.days: Depends on your lot address (지번) (e.g. Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri). Check by address with the district office's 'Disposal day search' (배출일시 검색)
seoul-jongno.place: In front of your own home or shop (general waste, food waste and recycling together, on the set days and times)
seoul-jongno.food: Put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투) (1, 2, 3 or 5 L), then in a food-waste bin with a lid, in front of your home
seoul-jongno.bulky: Apply for large household waste (대형생활폐기물) on the district office (구청) website or at the community center (동주민센터) → attach the certificate sticker (신고필증) and put it out
seoul-jongno.recyclingNotes: Clear PET bottles (투명페트병): remove the label, crush, put in a clear bag. Thursday (Sun·Tue·Thu areas) or Friday (Mon·Wed·Fri areas)

seoul-jung.name: Jung-gu
seoul-jung.hours: Residential areas: 19:00–24:00 / Main roads and special tourist zones (관광특구): 22:00–01:00 (next day)
seoul-jung.days: Every day, except the no-disposal day
seoul-jung.noPickupDay: Sogong-dong, Hoehyeon-dong, Euljiro-dong: Sunday / Jungnim, Pil, Jangchung, Gwanghui, Dasan, Sindang, Yaksu, Cheonggu, Sindang 5, Donghwa, Hwanghak-dong: Saturday / Myeong-dong: none
seoul-jung.place: In front of your own home or shop, or beside the building. Do not put it on the roadside (도로변)
seoul-jung.food: Houses: yellow food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), in front of your home. Apartments: special bin + payment sticker (납부필증) or RFID
seoul-jung.bulky: 'Bbegi' (빼기) app or website (bbegi.com), or call 1577-6731. Free pickup of large appliances: 1599-0903
seoul-jung.recyclingNotes: Plastic film/bags (비닐): separately, in a clear or semi-clear bag. Styrofoam (스티로폼): white only

seoul-yongsan.name: Yongsan-gu
seoul-yongsan.days: Sunday to Friday evenings (6 days a week from 2026)
seoul-yongsan.noPickupDay: No disposal on Saturday. Also no disposal on the day before a public holiday
seoul-yongsan.bulky: Apply for large household waste (대형생활폐기물) on the district office (구청) website
seoul-yongsan.recyclingNotes: Based on the district office's KakaoTalk channel. Please check again on the district office website

seoul-mapo.name: Mapo-gu
seoul-mapo.days: General and food waste: Sun·Mon·Tue·Wed·Thu / Recycling: clear PET bottles (투명페트병) and plastic film (비닐) on Wednesday, everything else Sun·Mon·Tue·Thu
seoul-mapo.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday and Saturday
seoul-mapo.place: In front of your own home or shop (building)
seoul-mapo.food: Houses: yellow food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), in the food-waste bin in front of your home (before 22:00 if possible)
seoul-mapo.bags: Shops with a 'garbage bag sales' sign (쓰레기봉투판매소)
seoul-mapo.bulky: smartclean.mapo.go.kr or the community center (동주민센터) → attach the sticker and put it out. Large appliances free: 1599-0903
seoul-mapo.recyclingNotes: On main roads, only 22:00–24:00. Breaking the day/time rules: fine (과태료) of 100,000 won

seoul-gangnam.name: Gangnam-gu
seoul-gangnam.days: Mon–Fri (some notices say Sun–Fri). Recycling: Thursday is only plastic film (비닐) and clear PET bottles (투명페트병); other recycling Mon·Tue·Wed·Fri·Sun
seoul-gangnam.place: Always in front of your own home or shop
seoul-gangnam.food: Drain the water, put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용 봉투), then in the food-waste bin. Apartments with RFID: use your card
seoul-gangnam.bulky: Apply online at clean.gangnam.go.kr, or call the contractor (대행업체) 3 days before
seoul-gangnam.recyclingNotes: Houses and villas (빌라): plastic film and clear PET bottles in a clear bag / white net bag; other recycling in a green net bag

seoul-seodaemun.name: Seodaemun-gu
seoul-seodaemun.days: Depends on the neighborhood (동). Mon·Wed·Fri: Cheonyeon, Hongje 1·2·3, Hongeun 2, Namgajwa 1·2, Bukgajwa 1-dong, etc. / Tue·Thu·Sun: Bukahyeon, Yeonhui, Hongeun 1, Bukgajwa 2-dong, Sinchon-dong (Changcheon), etc.
seoul-seodaemun.place: In front of your own home or shop
seoul-seodaemun.food: Put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), then in the collection bin
seoul-seodaemun.bags: 'Sales point search' (판매소 검색) on the district website
seoul-seodaemun.bulky: Report online at sdm.go.kr or call the contractor (대행업체) → attach the certificate sticker (신고필증) and put it out
seoul-seodaemun.recyclingNotes: Clear PET bottles (투명페트병): empty, remove the label, crush, put out separately. Plastic film (비닐) only with other film, in a clear bag

seoul-gwanak.name: Gwanak-gu
seoul-gwanak.days: Every day except Saturday (plastic film and clear PET bottles: Thursday only)
seoul-gwanak.place: In front of your own home or shop
seoul-gwanak.food: Houses and villas: drain the water, put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), then in the special bin
seoul-gwanak.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투) sales points (search locations on the district website). Special sacks (특수마대) at the community center (동주민센터)
seoul-gwanak.recyclingNotes: Plastic film (비닐) and clear PET bottles (투명페트병): each separately, Thursday only, in a clear or semi-clear bag. Apartments: depends on each complex

seoul-yeongdeungpo.name: Yeongdeungpo-gu
seoul-yeongdeungpo.days: Every day except Saturdays and public holidays. Clear PET bottles and plastic film: Thursday (houses and shops)
seoul-yeongdeungpo.noPickupDay: No disposal on Saturdays, public holidays, or holiday breaks (명절 연휴)
seoul-yeongdeungpo.place: Houses: in front of your own home or shop / Apartments: designated disposal spot
seoul-yeongdeungpo.food: Put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투), then in a bin near your home. RFID areas: use your card
seoul-yeongdeungpo.bags: Bag sales point near your home
seoul-yeongdeungpo.recyclingNotes: Blankets and pillows: report as large waste (대형폐기물)

gg-icheon.name: Icheon-si
gg-icheon.hours: From sunset the day before pickup until sunrise on pickup day (not in the daytime)
gg-icheon.days: Depends on the village (disposal spot). Check the timetable 'Garbage collection routes' (쓰레기 수거노선 안내) on the city website. No pickup on Sunday
gg-icheon.place: The disposal spot written in the pickup timetable
gg-icheon.bags: Only Icheon City pay-as-you-throw bags (이천시 종량제 봉투)
gg-icheon.bulky: Report first, then attach the sticker and put it out. Apply online on the city website (Resource Circulation Division 자원순환과: 031-644-2598)
gg-icheon.recyclingNotes: Put recycling in clear plastic bags or tie it with string. Broken fluorescent lamps go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투)

gg-ansan.name: Ansan-si
gg-ansan.hours: 20:00 the day before – 06:00 the next day
gg-ansan.days: Sangnok-gu: picked up every day except Sunday (don't put out on Saturday) / Recycling: put out Monday evening–Tuesday morning and Thursday evening–Friday morning
gg-ansan.place: In front of your own home or shop
gg-ansan.food: Orange food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), with the water drained
gg-ansan.bulky: Apply online, attach the fee sticker (납부필증) and put it out. Pickup Mon·Thu
gg-ansan.recyclingNotes: Recycling in clear or semi-clear plastic bags. Dirty items go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투)

gg-hwaseong.name: Hwaseong-si
gg-hwaseong.days: 2–3 times a week depending on the area (recycling at least once a week). Find your collection company on the city's living-space web portal (생활공간 웹포털)
gg-hwaseong.place: Always in a standard bag (규격봉투), at the designated spot
gg-hwaseong.food: Drain as much water as possible, then put it in a standard bag (규격봉투) or collection bin
gg-hwaseong.bulky: Buy a sticker at a sales point, attach it and call the company, or apply via 'Bbegi' (빼기, bbegi.com)
gg-hwaseong.recyclingNotes: Unsorted waste is not collected. Clear PET bottles (투명페트병): remove the label, crush, put in a clear bag

gg-suwon.name: Suwon-si
gg-suwon.hours: Houses: in front of your home after 20:00. End time differs by district (Jangan-gu 03:00, Paldal-gu 05:00)
gg-suwon.days: No pickup on Sunday. Recycling on your neighborhood's pickup day
gg-suwon.place: Houses: in front of your own home (putting it out in the daytime counts as illegal dumping (무단투기))
gg-suwon.food: Houses: food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투) / Apartments: special collection bin
gg-suwon.bulky: Buy a sticker at a shop and attach it, or report online at waste.suwon.go.kr
gg-suwon.recyclingNotes: Bundle by item type, in clear plastic bags

gg-siheung.name: Siheung-si
gg-siheung.days: General, food and recycling: Sun–Fri / Clear PET bottles: Thu·Fri
gg-siheung.noPickupDay: Do not put it out on Saturday (no pickup on Sunday)
gg-siheung.place: In front of your own home or shop
gg-siheung.food: Yellow pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) or special bin (chip 칩) / RFID, with the water drained
gg-siheung.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) sales points (supermarkets, convenience stores, etc.)
gg-siheung.bulky: Apply at waste.siheung.go.kr and attach the certificate sticker (신고필증), or use a sticker from a sales point
gg-siheung.recyclingNotes: There is a white bag (for burying, 묻는 용) and a pink bag (for burning, 태우는 용). Animal bones, shells and eggshells go in the general bag

gg-gimpo.name: Gimpo-si
gg-gimpo.days: Depends on the area. No pickup on Sunday
gg-gimpo.place: Designated disposal spot. Apartments: days set by the complex
gg-gimpo.bulky: Report online, then attach the sticker and put it out (from 2 days after applying)
gg-gimpo.recyclingNotes: White bag = general waste, yellow bag = special burnable waste (가연성 특수), white sack (흰 마대) = broken glass, etc.

gg-pyeongtaek.name: Pyeongtaek-si
gg-pyeongtaek.noPickupDay: No disposal from Saturday 04:00 to Sunday 20:00 (fine (과태료) of 100,000 won if you break this)
gg-pyeongtaek.place: Tie the pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) and put it at the designated spot
gg-pyeongtaek.food: Remove water and other objects, put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투), then in the collection bin. Take out plastic, bottle caps, shells and tea bags
gg-pyeongtaek.bulky: Report online on the city website, attach the certificate (필증), and put it out at 20:00 the day before pickup
gg-pyeongtaek.recyclingNotes: Usable appliances and furniture: free pickup by the recycling center (재활용센터)

busan-jung.name: Jung-gu
busan-jung.days: Sun·Tue·Thu: general and food waste / Mon: cans, bottles, scrap metal, plastic, milk cartons, clear PET bottles / Wed: paper, clothes, plastic film, styrofoam
busan-jung.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday or Saturday
busan-jung.place: In front of the gate of your home or shop
busan-jung.food: In a special food-waste bin with a payment sticker (납부필증, chip 칩), with the water drained
busan-jung.recyclingNotes: Wash recycling and put it in clear plastic bags

gwangju-gwangsan.name: Gwangsan-gu
gwangju-gwangsan.hours: Food waste: 20:00 – 06:00 the next morning (not in the daytime)
gwangju-gwangsan.days: Food waste pickup: Mon–Sat. For general waste and recycling days, check with the district office (구청)
gwangju-gwangsan.noPickupDay: Food waste: no disposal on Saturday or the day before a public holiday
gwangju-gwangsan.place: In front of your own home or shop, on the evening before pickup
gwangju-gwangsan.food: In front of your home, spread over the days (do not put it all out at once on Sunday)
gwangju-gwangsan.bulky: 'Large waste' (대형폐기물) menu on the district office website

seoul-gwangjin.name: Gwangjin-gu
seoul-gwangjin.days: Sun·Mon·Tue·Wed·Thu·Fri (same for general waste, food waste and recycling; same in every neighborhood)
seoul-gwangjin.noPickupDay: Do not put waste out on Saturday or the day before a public holiday
seoul-gwangjin.place: Houses: in front of your own home / Apartments: the way your complex decides
seoul-gwangjin.food: Houses: put the purple food-waste bag in a food-waste bin, in front of your home (the bin is free at the community center (동주민센터))
seoul-gwangjin.bags: Shops that sell pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제 봉투). Household bags are white
seoul-gwangjin.bulky: smartclean-gwangjin.kr or the community center (동주민센터) → attach the certificate sticker (신고필증) and put it in front of your home
seoul-gwangjin.recyclingNotes: Put each type in a clear plastic bag; tie boxes and styrofoam together. Breaking the day, time or place rules: fine of 100,000 won

seoul-guro.name: Guro-gu
seoul-guro.days: Depends on the neighborhood: Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri (ask the Cleaning Administration Division (청소행정과): 02-860-2912)
seoul-guro.place: Houses and small shops: in front of your own home (shop) / Apartments: the complex's collection point
seoul-guro.food: Put it in a yellow food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투) and put out the bag itself
seoul-guro.bags: Shops chosen by the district office (구청). General waste: white bag, food waste: yellow bag
seoul-guro.bulky: Apply on the district office website, call center 02-2615-3203, community center (주민센터), or the 'Ppaegi' (빼기) app
seoul-guro.recyclingNotes: Plastic film/vinyl goes separately in its own special bag (if you have none, a clear bag)

seoul-seongdong.name: Seongdong-gu
seoul-seongdong.days: General and food waste: Mon·Wed·Fri or Tue·Thu·Sun, depending on the neighborhood / Recycling: Thursday is only for clear PET bottles and plastic film; everything else on Sun·Mon·Tue·Wed·Fri
seoul-seongdong.noPickupDay: Saturday is not a disposal day. Breaking this rule: fine of 100,000 won
seoul-seongdong.place: Houses and offices: always in front of the building / Apartments: the place set by the complex
seoul-seongdong.food: Houses: put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투), then in a food-waste bin, in front of your gate
seoul-seongdong.bags: Shops that sell pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제 봉투). As a rule, use Seongdong-gu bags
seoul-seongdong.bulky: 02-2248-1001, the district office website, or the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app
seoul-seongdong.recyclingNotes: Collect bottles, cans and plastic in a clear bag; tie paper together

seoul-dongdaemun.name: Dongdaemun-gu
seoul-dongdaemun.days: Mon·Wed·Fri: Yongsin-dong, Jeonnong 2-dong, Dapsimni 1-dong, Jangan 2-dong, Hoegi-dong, Hwigyeong 1·2-dong / Sun·Tue·Thu: Jegi-dong, Jeonnong 1-dong, Dapsimni 2-dong, Jangan 1-dong, Cheongnyangni-dong, Imun 1·2-dong
seoul-dongdaemun.place: In front of your home (general waste, food waste and recycling, separated, put out together)
seoul-dongdaemun.food: Yellow food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투)
seoul-dongdaemun.bags: Shops that sell pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제 봉투). General waste: white, food waste: yellow
seoul-dongdaemun.bulky: 'Yeogiro' (여기로, yeogiro24.co.kr) or the community center (동주민센터) → attach the disposal number. Large appliances free: 1599-0903
seoul-dongdaemun.recyclingNotes: Mon·Wed·Fri neighborhoods: recycling Mon·Wed, plastic film and clear PET bottles Fri / Sun·Tue·Thu neighborhoods: recycling Sun·Tue, plastic film and clear PET bottles Thu

incheon-yeongjong.name: Yeongjong-gu
incheon-yeongjong.days: General waste: the day before pickup day. Food waste (houses): Unseo 1·2-dong Sun·Tue·Thu / Yeongjong-dong, Yeongjong 1·2-dong, Yongyu-dong Mon·Wed·Fri
incheon-yeongjong.place: In front of your own home or shop
incheon-yeongjong.food: Houses: in a food-waste bin with a payment sticker (납부필증) attached, in front of your home / Apartments: collection bins or RFID
incheon-yeongjong.bags: Designated shops. Old Jung-gu bags can also be used
incheon-yeongjong.bulky: 'Yeogiro' (여기로, yeogiro24.co.kr) or a sticker from a bag shop. Appliances free: 1599-0903
incheon-yeongjong.recyclingNotes: Since July 2026, the Yeongjong area of Jung-gu, Incheon is Yeongjong-gu (Yeongjongdo island, around Incheon Airport)

incheon-yeonsu.name: Yeonsu-gu
incheon-yeonsu.hours: On disposal days 18:00 – 04:00 the next morning
incheon-yeonsu.days: General waste: every day except Saturday / Food waste: Ongnyeon, Yeonsu Tue·Thu·Sun; Seonhak, Cheonghak, Dongchun Mon·Wed·Fri; Songdo every day except Saturday / Recycling: Ongnyeon, Yeonsu, Songdo 1·4·5 Tue·Thu·Sun; Cheonghak, Dongchun, Seonhak, Songdo 2·3 Mon·Wed·Fri
incheon-yeonsu.place: Houses and shops: in front of your building / Apartments: designated place / Songdo areas with an automatic waste collection system: into the inlet
incheon-yeonsu.food: Apartments: RFID / Houses and shops: food-waste bin + payment sticker (납부필증) / Songdo automatic collection areas: food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투)
incheon-yeonsu.bulky: Report online on the district office website, the 'Ppaegi' (빼기) app, 032-562-1008, or a sticker from a bag shop
incheon-yeonsu.recyclingNotes: Recycling goes in clear plastic bags. Bedding, rubber, etc. in the yellow bag; glass and ceramics in a sack (마대)

seoul-gangdong.name: Gangdong-gu
seoul-gangdong.days: Every day (except Saturday and the day before a public holiday). Plastic film (비닐) and clear PET bottles (투명 페트병): Thursday only
seoul-gangdong.noPickupDay: Saturday, the day before a public holiday
seoul-gangdong.place: In front of your own home or shop, or at the designated disposal spot
seoul-gangdong.food: Drain the water and remove foreign objects. Use a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투), a payment sticker (납부필증), or an RFID food-waste machine
seoul-gangdong.bulky: Apply online for large waste (대형폐기물) on the district office (구청) website (gangdong.go.kr), pay the fee, then put it out. Apply at least 2 days before the disposal day
seoul-gangdong.recyclingNotes: Plastic film and clear PET bottles: Thursday only (no other recycling that day). Broken glass and ceramics: special sack (특수마대)

seoul-gangseo.name: Gangseo-gu
seoul-gangseo.hours: General waste 19:00–24:00, food waste 18:00–24:00, recycling from sunset to 24:00
seoul-gangseo.days: 5 days a week: Sun·Mon·Tue·Wed·Thu (not Fri or Sat). Apartments (공동주택): recycling on the day set by each complex
seoul-gangseo.place: In front of your own home or shop
seoul-gangseo.food: Remove water and foreign objects, put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투), then in the collection bin. Houses with an RFID machine: put it in the machine
seoul-gangseo.bulky: Apply for large waste (대형폐기물) on the district office website ('Bbegi' 빼기, bbegi.com), attach the reservation number, and put it out in the evening of the disposal day (after sunset until midnight)
seoul-gangseo.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a clear or semi-clear plastic bag (no black bags). Broken glass: wrap it in newspaper and put it in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투)

seoul-geumcheon.name: Geumcheon-gu
seoul-geumcheon.hours: 18:00–24:00 (shops on main roads such as Siheung-daero: 22:00–01:00 next day)
seoul-geumcheon.noPickupDay: Saturday, the day before a public holiday, the last Friday of each month (the day before the last Saturday)
seoul-geumcheon.place: In front of your own home (gate) or shop. Not on the sidewalk or in front of street trees
seoul-geumcheon.food: Drain the water, put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), then in the special bin in front of your home. Apartments: RFID card
seoul-geumcheon.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops (종량제 봉투 판매소) — find locations on the district website
seoul-geumcheon.bulky: Report online (smartclean.geumcheon.go.kr) or by phone to the community center (동주민센터) or the Cleaning Administration Division (청소행정과), then put it out
seoul-geumcheon.recyclingNotes: Plastic film and clear PET bottles: Thursday. Other recycling: Sun–Wed and Fri. Use a clear bag (black bags are not collected)

seoul-nowon.name: Nowon-gu
seoul-nowon.days: Houses and shops: Sunday–Friday (except public holidays). Apartments and shops inside apartment complexes: pickup 3 times a week
seoul-nowon.noPickupDay: Saturday, the day before a public holiday
seoul-nowon.place: In front of your own home or shop (not on the sidewalk, road, utility poles or street trees). Apartments: designated spot
seoul-nowon.food: Houses: on the set days after 18:00, in the collection bin with a payment sticker (납부필증), in front of your door. Apartments: special bins or RFID
seoul-nowon.bags: Designated shops such as convenience stores and supermarkets
seoul-nowon.bulky: Apply and pay online at Smart Clean Nowon (smartclean.nowon.kr), then attach the disposal certificate, or report in person at the community center (주민센터)
seoul-nowon.recyclingNotes: Clear PET bottles and plastic film: Thursday only. Other recycling: every day except Thursday and Saturday. Briquette ash (연탄재): Tuesday

seoul-dobong.name: Dobong-gu
seoul-dobong.noPickupDay: Saturday, the day before a public holiday (large waste is also not allowed on Friday and Saturday)
seoul-dobong.place: In front of your own home or shop
seoul-dobong.food: Houses: attach the payment certificate (납부확인증) that matches your special bin. Apartments: special bins or RFID food-waste machines
seoul-dobong.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops (종량제봉투 판매소) — see the shop map and list on the district website
seoul-dobong.bulky: Apply at Smart Clean Dobong (smartclean.dobong.go.kr) or on the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app, or at the community center (주민센터)
seoul-dobong.recyclingNotes: Recycling must go in a clear plastic bag. If recycling is mixed into a pay-as-you-throw bag, it will not be collected

seoul-dongjak.name: Dongjak-gu
seoul-dongjak.days: Any day except Saturday and the day before a public holiday. Plastic film, clear PET bottles, small appliances and batteries: Thursday and Sunday only
seoul-dongjak.noPickupDay: Saturday, the day before a public holiday
seoul-dongjak.place: In front of your own home (door-to-door)
seoul-dongjak.food: Remove water and foreign objects, put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), then in the collection bin in front of your door. Apartments: the complex's special bins
seoul-dongjak.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops (종량제봉투 판매소) (list on the district website)
seoul-dongjak.bulky: 2–3 days before, call the contractor (대행업체) or apply online (smartclean.dongjak.go.kr), then put it in front of your home
seoul-dongjak.recyclingNotes: Blankets, pillows, old clothes and stuffed toys: special pay-as-you-throw sack (특수종량제봉투, 마대) or as large waste. Recycling in a clear bag

seoul-seocho.name: Seocho-gu
seoul-seocho.hours: 18:00–01:00 next day (buildings, shops and stores on main roads: from 22:00)
seoul-seocho.days: General waste and recycling: every other day depending on the dong (Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri). Food waste: every day
seoul-seocho.noPickupDay: Saturday, the day before a public holiday (no waste of any kind)
seoul-seocho.place: In front of your own home or shop
seoul-seocho.food: Remove foreign objects, squeeze out the water, put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), then in the collection bin. Apartments with RFID: any time
seoul-seocho.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops such as nearby supermarkets and convenience stores
seoul-seocho.bulky: Call the local collection company, apply online on the district website (seocho.go.kr), or use the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app
seoul-seocho.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a see-through clear bag, sorted by type. Outside disposal hours, keep it inside the building

seoul-seongbuk.name: Seongbuk-gu
seoul-seongbuk.days: Depends on the dong: Mon·Wed·Fri or Tue·Thu·Sun (recycling in some dongs: Sun–Fri). Check your dong's schedule
seoul-seongbuk.noPickupDay: Saturday evening, the evening before a weekday public holiday (please do not put waste out)
seoul-seongbuk.place: In front of your own home or shop
seoul-seongbuk.food: Put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제봉투) (apartments: special bins)
seoul-seongbuk.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops (special sacks 특수마대 are also sold there)
seoul-seongbuk.bulky: Call the contractor (Cheonil Energy 천일에너지, 1866-0554) or report online (smartclean.sb.go.kr), then put it out
seoul-seongbuk.recyclingNotes: Put recycling in a clear bag or tie it with string. Clothes, bedding and non-burnable waste: special sack (특수마대)

seoul-songpa.name: Songpa-gu
seoul-songpa.days: Houses: Mon·Wed·Fri or Tue·Thu·Sun depending on the dong (general and food waste). Apartments etc.: pickup every day
seoul-songpa.place: In front of your own gate (designated spot)
seoul-songpa.food: Houses: food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제봉투) in the special bin, or an RFID machine. Apartments: RFID machine
seoul-songpa.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops (list of shops by dong on the district website)
seoul-songpa.bulky: Report online at Smart Clean Songpa (smartclean.songpa.go.kr), use the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app, or call the cleaning contractor
seoul-songpa.recyclingNotes: Plastic film and PET bottles: Friday or Thursday depending on the dong. Other recycling: Mon·Wed or Tue·Sun. Putting it out in the daytime: fine (과태료)

seoul-eunpyeong.name: Eunpyeong-gu
seoul-eunpyeong.days: Depends on the dong: Mon·Wed·Fri (Bulgwang 2, Eungam 1–3, Yeokchon, Sinsa 1, Jingwan) or Sun·Tue·Thu (other dongs)
seoul-eunpyeong.place: In front of your own gate (wall) or shop
seoul-eunpyeong.food: Houses: purple food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), in front of the building (same days as general waste). Apartments: collection bins or RFID
seoul-eunpyeong.bags: Designated shops (find locations on the district website)
seoul-eunpyeong.bulky: Smart Clean Eunpyeong (smartclean.ep.go.kr), the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app, or apply in person at the community center (동주민센터)
seoul-eunpyeong.recyclingNotes: Sort recycling by type. Plastic film is recycled only if it has the recycling mark (분리배출 표시)

seoul-jungnang.name: Jungnang-gu
seoul-jungnang.days: Depends on the dong: Mon·Wed·Fri (Mangubon, Myeonmok 3·8, 5, 7, Sangbong 2, Muk 1·2, Sinnae 1·2) or Sun·Tue·Thu (others). Apartments: days set by each complex
seoul-jungnang.place: In front of your home (houses and shops)
seoul-jungnang.food: Houses: on the set days 18:00–20:00, in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제봉투) inside the special collection bin (25L), in front of your home
seoul-jungnang.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops (payment stickers 납부필증 for restaurants are sold at the same place)
seoul-jungnang.bulky: Report at the online center (smartclean-jungnang.kr) or by phone to the collection company, then put it in front of your home
seoul-jungnang.recyclingNotes: All recycling in a clear plastic bag. Clear PET bottles: remove the label and put them out separately

gg-gunpo.name: Gunpo-si
gg-gunpo.days: Any time except Saturday afternoon and Sunday
gg-gunpo.noPickupDay: No disposal from Saturday afternoon to Sunday (dong notice: no pickup from Saturday 12:00 to Sunday 20:00)
gg-gunpo.place: In front of your own home
gg-gunpo.food: Use a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 전용 종량제봉투), or attach a fee chip (종량제칩) or payment sticker (납부필증) to a special collection bin
gg-gunpo.bulky: Attach a disposal sticker, or report large waste (대형폐기물) on the city website (gunpo.go.kr/waste)
gg-gunpo.recyclingNotes: Clear PET bottles: remove the label and crush them. Paper cartons and clear PET bottles can be exchanged for pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제봉투) at the community center (동 행정복지센터)

gg-gwangju.name: Gwangju-si
gg-gwangju.days: Put it out the evening before pickup (pickup: weekdays 06:00–15:00, Saturday 06:00–12:00)
gg-gwangju.noPickupDay: No pickup after 14:00 on Saturday, on Sunday or on public holidays (changes during major holidays 명절)
gg-gwangju.place: Designated disposal spot (Gyeongan-dong and Yeok-dong: in front of your own home or shop)
gg-gwangju.food: Drain as much water as possible and put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투). Shells, bones and tea bags are general waste
gg-gwangju.bulky: Apply on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app or website (yeogiro24.co.kr), or buy a payment sticker (납부필증), attach it and call the collection company
gg-gwangju.recyclingNotes: Remove foreign matter and put it in a clear bag. Dirty recycling goes in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투)

gg-yeoju.name: Yeoju-si
gg-yeoju.noPickupDay: No disposal all day Saturday (no disposal from Friday 06:00 to Sunday 18:00). No disposal in the daytime
gg-yeoju.bulky: Check the price list by item, then put it out (yeoju.go.kr/waste). Free pickup of old appliances, reservation: 1599-0903
gg-yeoju.recyclingNotes: Plastic dirty with food or other matter goes in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투). Put clear PET bottles out separately

gg-anseong.name: Anseong-si
gg-anseong.days: No pickup on Sunday → do not put waste out on Saturday evening (pickup schedule by area: asimc.or.kr)
gg-anseong.noPickupDay: No disposal on Saturday evening (no pickup on Sunday)
gg-anseong.food: Drain the water and put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제봉투)
gg-anseong.bulky: Apply on the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app or website (bbegi.com), or buy a sticker at a supermarket or convenience store and attach it
gg-anseong.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a clear bag. Clear PET bottles: remove the label, crush, and put out separately. Spray cans: make a hole

incheon-namdong.name: Namdong-gu
incheon-namdong.days: Depends on the dong (e.g. Mansu 1-dong: Sun·Mon·Tue·Wed·Thu, 5 times a week)
incheon-namdong.place: In front of your own home or at the storage rack
incheon-namdong.food: Houses: drain the water, put it in a food-waste bag (전용봉투), in front of your home. Apartments: the complex's collection area or RFID machine
incheon-namdong.bulky: Buy a sticker at the community center (행정복지센터), on the district website, on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app, or at a shop, and attach it
incheon-namdong.recyclingNotes: Put it in a clear bag, tie it, and put it out. Clear PET bottles separately. Days are set by each dong

incheon-michuhol.name: Michuhol-gu
incheon-michuhol.place: In a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투), in front of your door
incheon-michuhol.food: In a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제봉투) inside the special collection bin, on your dong's days (Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri), 19:00–24:00. Buildings with 100+ households: RFID
incheon-michuhol.bulky: Online (michuhol.go.kr/bigclean), the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app, an unmanned kiosk, or a sticker shop. Put it out the day before pickup, 17:00–midnight
incheon-michuhol.recyclingNotes: On your dong's days (Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri), 19:00–24:00, washed, in a clear bag. PET bottles: remove the label, crush, and put out separately

incheon-seo.name: Seohae-gu (formerly Seo-gu)
incheon-seo.days: Sunday–Friday evening (pickup Mon–Sat). Food waste and recycling: Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri depending on the dong
incheon-seo.food: In the special collection bin with a payment sticker (납부필증) attached, in front of your door. Cheongna: in a special bag, into the Clean Net (크린넷) at any time
incheon-seo.bulky: Report and pay online, attach the certificate (신고필증), and put it in front of your door 20:00–24:00 the day before pickup (waste.seo.incheon.kr)
incheon-seo.recyclingNotes: Clear PET bottles: remove the label, crush, and put out separately. Diapers and plastic-coated paper go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투)

incheon-gyeyang.name: Gyeyang-gu
incheon-gyeyang.place: In front of your own gate
incheon-gyeyang.food: Apartments with 20+ households: 120L special bin. Houses: light-green food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투)
incheon-gyeyang.bulky: Attach a sticker from a shop and report to 1555-0115, or report online on the district website. Put it out the day before pickup, 19:00–midnight
incheon-gyeyang.recyclingNotes: Clear PET bottles: Thursday. In some dongs the recycling days are different, so check your dong

daejeon-yuseong.name: Yuseong-gu
daejeon-yuseong.days: General and food waste: every day (except Fri and Sat). Recycling: evening of the day set for your dong (see the southern/northern area schedules)
daejeon-yuseong.place: Regular areas: in front of your home (shop) / Apartments: spot chosen by the manager / Doan Clean Net (크린넷) area: pay-as-you-throw and food waste into the Clean Net inlet
daejeon-yuseong.food: Put it in a special bin, attach a payment sticker (납부필증) matching the bin, and put it in front of your home (not collected in plastic bags). Doan Clean Net area: special bag into the inlet
daejeon-yuseong.bulky: Report, then attach the certificate (신고필증) and put it out. Certificate: district office (구청), community center (동 행정복지센터), district website (yuseong.go.kr/clean), 'Bbegi' (빼기) app
daejeon-yuseong.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a clear bag, in front of your home on the evening before your dong's disposal day. Free pickup of old appliances: 1599-0903

daejeon-seo.name: Seo-gu
daejeon-seo.noPickupDay: Friday, Saturday (no waste of any kind)
daejeon-seo.place: Regular: in front of your own home or shop / Apartments: designated disposal spot / Clean Net (크린넷) areas: Clean Net inlet
daejeon-seo.food: Put it in the collection bin, hang a payment sticker (납부필증) matching the size, and put it in front of your gate after 18:00. Apartments: shared bins (120L). Doan district: special bag into the Clean Net
daejeon-seo.bags: Buy payment stickers (납부필증) at pay-as-you-throw bag shops (종량제봉투 판매소)
daejeon-seo.bulky: Visit the community center (동 행정복지센터), or report on the district website (seogu.go.kr) or the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app, then attach the sticker and disposal number
daejeon-seo.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a clear or semi-clear plastic bag, in front of your home after sunset on the evening before your dong's pickup. Seo-gu pay-as-you-throw bags can be used only in Seo-gu

daejeon-dong.name: Dong-gu
daejeon-dong.hours: 18:00 the day before – 02:00 the next day
daejeon-dong.days: General waste (including food waste): every day (except Fri and Sat). Recycling and large waste: the day before your dong's pickup day
daejeon-dong.place: In front of your own home or workplace
daejeon-dong.food: Put it in a household bin (5L), attach a payment sticker (납부필증), and put it outside the door on the 1st floor
daejeon-dong.bulky: Buy a sticker at the community center (동 행정복지센터) or report online on the district website (donggu.go.kr/dg/kor/60/wasteApply), attach it, and put it out on your dong's pickup schedule
daejeon-dong.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a clear plastic bag or a paper bag, in front of your home on your dong's pickup schedule. Free pickup of old appliances: 1599-0903

sejong.name: Sejong
sejong.hours: Eup/myeon (town and rural) areas: from the evening before until before 06:00 on pickup day (disposal hours for dong areas were not confirmed)
sejong.days: Dong areas differ by living zone (생활권) (e.g. zones 1·2: household waste (not Clean Net) on Monday; zones 3–6: Mon–Sat). Eup/myeon: differs by area
sejong.place: Houses and shops: in front of your home (recycling) / Apartments: disposal spot in the complex / Clean Net (크린넷) areas: Clean Net inlet
sejong.food: Use a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물용 종량제봉투). In Clean Net areas, do not put it into the same inlet as general waste
sejong.bulky: Attach a sticker for the item and put it out. Stickers: designated shops or online (sjwaste.kr)
sejong.recyclingNotes: Do not use 100L bags. Blankets, building materials, butane gas cans etc. must not go into the Clean Net

cb-cheongju.name: Cheongju-si
cb-cheongju.hours: On the disposal day, from sunset until before midnight
cb-cheongju.days: Sunday–Thursday (based on the Seowon-gu office notice)
cb-cheongju.place: In front of your home or at a designated spot (in alleys, a designated spot the garbage truck can reach)
cb-cheongju.food: Special collection bin (3–120L) with a payment sticker (납부필증), put out the day before pickup from sunset to 24:00. Apartments: shared bin at the designated spot
cb-cheongju.bags: Designated shops such as supermarkets, convenience stores and hardware stores
cb-cheongju.bulky: Report at the community center (동 주민센터) or online (clean.cheongju.go.kr), attach the certificate (신고필증, sticker), and put it out
cb-cheongju.recyclingNotes: Burnable waste: yellow pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투). Non-burnable waste (broken glass, dishes etc.): purple sack (마대). Recycling in a clear bag

cb-jincheon.name: Jincheon-gun
cb-jincheon.hours: After sunset the day before pickup (19:00–04:00)
cb-jincheon.days: Pickup: burnable waste Tue·Thu·Sat, non-burnable waste Mon·Wed·Fri (06:00 in the morning). Put it out the day before pickup
cb-jincheon.food: Houses: drain the water, put it in a yellow (pay-as-you-throw) bag, then in the special bin with an orange lid. Apartments: special bin with a green lid
cb-jincheon.bulky: Attach a sticker for the item and report to the call center, or pay online ('Yeogiro' 여기로, yeogiro24.co.kr) and attach the certificate
cb-jincheon.recyclingNotes: Burnable waste: red or green pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제봉투). Non-burnable waste: 30L green non-burnable sack (불연성마대). Briquette ash: clear bag (free)

cb-eumseong.name: Eumseong-gun
cb-eumseong.days: Pickup: Mon–Fri 06:00–15:00, Sat 06:00–11:30 (no pickup on Sundays and public holidays)
cb-eumseong.food: Drain the water and put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물쓰레기 종량제봉투). Areas with RFID equipment: put it in the machine
cb-eumseong.bulky: Report and pay on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app or website (yeogiro24.co.kr), write the disposal number, attach it and put it out
cb-eumseong.recyclingNotes: Burnable waste and non-burnable waste (broken dishes, ceramics etc.) each use their own pay-as-you-throw bag. Free pickup of old appliances: 1599-0903

cb-chungju.name: Chungju-si
cb-chungju.days: Sunday–Friday. Recycling (city center): north of Gyohyeoncheon stream Tue·Thu·Sun evening, south Mon·Wed·Fri evening
cb-chungju.noPickupDay: Saturday (stated as a day when food waste must not be put out)
cb-chungju.place: In front of your own home or shop (apartment food waste: shared collection bins)
cb-chungju.food: City-center houses etc.: put a payment chip (납부필증, 칩) in the bin by your door, in front of your gate. Eup/myeon and apartments: green food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제봉투) into the shared bin
cb-chungju.recyclingNotes: Burnable waste: white or reusable pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제봉투). Non-burnable waste: pay-as-you-throw sack (마대). Do not leave waste under street trees or utility poles

cn-cheonan.name: Cheonan-si
cn-cheonan.noPickupDay: No disposal from Saturday 17:00 to Sunday 19:00 (no pickup on Sunday)
cn-cheonan.food: Red food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), at the disposal spot after sunset. In the special collection bins, also use the pay-as-you-throw bag
cn-cheonan.bags: Where to buy pay-as-you-throw bags, sacks and large-waste stickers: ask Cheonan Urban Corporation (천안도시공사, 529-5100)
cn-cheonan.bulky: Buy a sticker at a designated shop, or report online or apply on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app, attach it, and put it at the disposal spot
cn-cheonan.recyclingNotes: Put clear PET bottles out separately. Free pickup of old appliances: 1599-0903

cn-asan.name: Asan-si
cn-asan.days: The pickup schedule depends on your address, so ask (food-waste pickup days differ by area)
cn-asan.noPickupDay: Saturday (food waste; no pickup on Sunday)
cn-asan.place: Waste disposal spot / Food waste: collection bin in front of your home
cn-asan.food: In a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), in the collection bin in front of your home. Where there is no bin: a special bag, or your own bin with a payment sticker (납부필증), at the designated spot
cn-asan.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops. Food-waste bags and stickers: designated shops such as convenience stores and supermarkets
cn-asan.bulky: Report large waste online (smartclean.asan.go.kr), pay, and print the certificate, or buy a sticker at a shop or the eup/myeon/dong office (읍면동)
cn-asan.recyclingNotes: Non-burnable waste: red standard sack (적색마대). Briquette ash: clear bag. Gas cans and butane cans: make a hole before putting them out

cn-dangjin.name: Dangjin-si
cn-dangjin.days: Recycling: Dangjin 1·2·3-dong pickup Mon–Fri (put out after sunset). Eup/myeon: days differ by area
cn-dangjin.food: Remove foreign objects and water, and put it in a green food-waste standard bag (규격봉투)
cn-dangjin.bulky: Call the collection company (Gagok Hwangyeong 가곡환경, 354-1929) and attach a sticker, or report online (link on the city website)
cn-dangjin.recyclingNotes: Items hard to fit in a standard bag: special standard bags (특수규격봉투, 20L·60L). Recycling separately, in clear bags etc.

busan-saha.name: Saha-gu
busan-saha.days: Sun·Tue·Thu: general (burnable) + food waste / Mon: recycling (plastic, plastic film, clothes etc.) / Wed: recycling (clear PET, paper, cans, bottles etc.) + non-burnable waste and small appliances
busan-saha.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday and Saturday
busan-saha.place: In front of your gate (row houses 연립주택: outside the 1st-floor entrance)
busan-saha.food: Drain the water; special bin with a payment chip (납부필증, 칩). Sun·Tue·Thu 19:00–22:00 (apartments: time set by each complex)
busan-saha.bulky: Call or text the contractor Malgeun Saha Hwangyeong (맑은사하환경, 051-266-1170~1), or use the KakaoTalk channel '맑은사하환경'. Fridges, TVs, washing machines etc.: free pickup 1599-0903
busan-saha.recyclingNotes: Putting recycling in a pay-as-you-throw bag or mixing it with general waste: fine (과태료). Sort by item and put out only on the set days

busan-sasang.name: Sasang-gu
busan-sasang.days: Sun·Tue·Thu: general + food waste (Thursday also non-burnable waste and briquette ash) / Mon: recycling (bottles, plastic film, paper, styrofoam, clothes etc.) / Wed: recycling (plastic, cans, scrap metal, clear PET, small appliances)
busan-sasang.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday and Saturday
busan-sasang.place: At the house gate, the 1st-floor building entrance, or in front of the shop. Apartments: day, time and place set by the complex
busan-sasang.food: Squeeze out the water well, remove bones, shells, plastic and other foreign objects, and put it in the special collection bin (Sun·Tue·Thu)
busan-sasang.bags: Designated pay-as-you-throw bag shops in Sasang-gu
busan-sasang.bulky: Call Woori Hwangyeong ((유)우리환경, 051-324-4600) or apply at uuri.kr. Large appliances, free pickup: 1599-0903
busan-sasang.recyclingNotes: Non-burnable waste (shells, bones etc.): non-burnable sack (불연성마대). Old medicines: collection boxes at the public health center (보건소) or community center (동 행정복지센터)

busan-nam.name: Nam-gu
busan-nam.days: Sun·Tue·Thu: general + food waste / Mon: recycling (paper, paper cartons, plastic film, plastic, clear PET etc.) / Wed: recycling (cans, scrap metal, glass bottles, clothes, styrofoam) + non-burnable waste, small appliances, briquette ash
busan-nam.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday and Saturday
busan-nam.place: In front of your own gate or the 1st-floor entrance of your business. Apartments and shopping buildings: designated spot
busan-nam.food: Special bin with a payment sticker (납부필증) (Sun·Tue·Thu). Bones, shells and hard peels go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투)
busan-nam.bulky: Apply online at the Nam-gu resource circulation portal (bsnamgu.go.kr), or call Gyeongin Sanup (경인산업) 051-631-7868~9 / Goryeo Sanup (고려산업) 051-628-4373~4. Put it on the road in front of your gate
busan-nam.recyclingNotes: Tie recycling by item with string or put it in a white (clear) bag. Non-burnable waste: special sack (전용마대)

busan-geumjeong.name: Geumjeong-gu
busan-geumjeong.days: Sun·Tue·Thu: general (burnable) + food waste / Mon: recycling (paper, clothes, plastic film, colored PET), styrofoam, small appliances / Wed: recycling (plastic, glass bottles, cans, scrap metal, clear PET), non-burnable waste, briquette ash
busan-geumjeong.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday and Saturday
busan-geumjeong.place: In front of your own gate or the 1st-floor entrance of your business
busan-geumjeong.food: Drain as much water as possible; Geumjeong-gu special bin with a payment certificate (납부증명서), Sun·Tue·Thu 19:00–22:00
busan-geumjeong.bulky: Woori Hwangyeong ((유)우리환경) ☎526-9787~9, or apply online via Naver Store '유한회사우리환경' or the KakaoTalk channel
busan-geumjeong.recyclingNotes: Fabric items such as blankets, pillows and throws, and cotton stuffing: as large waste. Old medicines: pharmacy or public health center (보건소)

busan-dongnae.name: Dongnae-gu
busan-dongnae.days: Sun·Thu: pay-as-you-throw bags + food waste / Tue: pay-as-you-throw bags (burnable and non-burnable) + clothes, plastic film + small appliances + food waste / Mon: plastic, colored PET, paper cartons / Wed: clear PET, cans, scrap metal, styrofoam, glass bottles, paper, briquette ash
busan-dongnae.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday and Saturday
busan-dongnae.place: Houses: in front of the gate. Businesses: in front of the door. Apartments with fewer than 20 households: in front of the 1st-floor entrance
busan-dongnae.food: Remove water and foreign objects (shells, bones, fruit seeds etc.); special collection bin with a payment sticker (납부필증). Not collected if you put it in with the plastic bag
busan-dongnae.bulky: Woori Hwangyeong (우리환경) ☎552-1022, 524-1025, or apply at uuri2.kr or on Naver Shopping
busan-dongnae.recyclingNotes: Small amounts of construction waste: Thursday. Without standard bags or with mixed waste, a 'collection refused' sticker (수거거부 스티커) is attached and it is not taken

busan-gijang.name: Gijang-gun
busan-gijang.days: Door-to-door pickup areas: Sun·Tue·Thu pay-as-you-throw bags + food waste / Mon recycling (clear PET, cans, bottles, plastic film, scrap metal, clothes) / Wed recycling (paper, plastic, styrofoam etc.). Bell-pickup areas: days set by each village
busan-gijang.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday and Saturday (door-to-door pickup areas)
busan-gijang.place: In front of the gate, 1st-floor entrance
busan-gijang.food: Remove foreign objects and water, put it in the special bin with a payment chip (납부필증, 칩), in front of your home
busan-gijang.bulky: Apply and pay on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app or www.yeogiro24.co.kr, write the disposal number and put it out, or call Gijang-gun Urban Management Corporation (기장군도시관리공단) ☎051-792-4725
busan-gijang.recyclingNotes: Non-burnable waste: 1st and 3rd Thursday of each month, in a non-burnable sack (불연성 마대). Recycling in a clear bag (no black bags)

ulsan-nam.name: Nam-gu
ulsan-nam.hours: From sunset the day before pickup until 03:00 on pickup day
ulsan-nam.days: General waste: pickup Mon–Sat (put out the evening before; no pickup on Sunday). Food waste and recycling differ by dong: e.g. food waste put out Sun·Tue·Thu evening or Mon·Wed·Fri evening
ulsan-nam.place: Houses (shops): in front of your own home (shop). Apartments: storage bins in the complex. Under utility poles or by the road: illegal
ulsan-nam.food: Special bin with a payment sticker (납부필증). Take the empty bin back right after pickup
ulsan-nam.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops (download the list from the district website)
ulsan-nam.bulky: Report to your dong's collection company, then put it out (Taehwa Sanup 태화산업 269-6512, Iljin Hwangyeong 일진환경 274-2824, Samjeong Gaebal 삼정개발 257-5878, Samhwa Silup 삼화실업 227-5360). Medium and large appliances: 1599-0903
ulsan-nam.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a net bag (그물망) (free at the community center 동 행정복지센터). Throwing it out in a black or other non-see-through bag: fine (과태료)

ulsan-dong.name: Dong-gu
ulsan-dong.days: General and food waste: put out Sun–Thu evening (pickup Mon–Fri). Recycling (houses and shops): Mon paper, Tue styrofoam and empty bottles, Wed plastic film, Thu cans, scrap metal and plastic, Fri clear PET (put out the evening before)
ulsan-dong.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday and Saturday
ulsan-dong.place: In front of the gate (apartments: designated collection bins)
ulsan-dong.food: Buy a payment sticker (납부필증) at a pay-as-you-throw bag shop, write your name on it, wrap it around the special bin's handle, and put it in front of your door
ulsan-dong.bulky: Report on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) website (yeogiro24.co.kr) or app, or call your dong's company (Pilhwangyeong 필환경 052-236-7900, Pungsan Gieop 풍산기업 052-201-4261, Useong Hwangyeong 우성환경 052-234-8394)
ulsan-dong.recyclingNotes: Wash recycling clean and put it in a net bag (그물망) (if lost, free at the community center 동 행정복지센터). Small appliances: collection box at the community center

daegu-dalseo.name: Dalseo-gu
daegu-dalseo.days: Pay-as-you-throw bags: put out Sunday evening–Friday (no pickup on Sunday). Food waste: Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri evening depending on the dong. Recycling: pickup every other day (differs by dong)
daegu-dalseo.place: In front of your home (apartments: designated spot in the complex)
daegu-dalseo.food: Dalseo-gu special collection bin with a payment sticker (납부필증), in front of your home or shop. Apartments: designated collection bins
daegu-dalseo.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops such as nearby supermarkets and convenience stores
daegu-dalseo.bulky: Apply and pay on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app or www.yeogiro24.co.kr, or call the collection company 3–4 days before. Write the disposal number and put it in front of your gate
daegu-dalseo.recyclingNotes: Houses, shops and one-room buildings (원룸): in a clear plastic bag or a combined recycling bag (통합가방), in front of your home. Bag weight: 50L up to 13kg, 75L up to 19kg

daegu-buk.name: Buk-gu
daegu-buk.days: Pay-as-you-throw bags: Sun–Fri (not Saturday). Food waste and recycling: Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri evening depending on the dong
daegu-buk.place: Houses and businesses: in front of the gate (business). Multi-unit and row houses: in front of the 1st-floor main entrance, by unit
daegu-buk.food: Wrap the payment sticker (납부필증, bought at pay-as-you-throw bag shops) around the special bin's handle; in front of your gate. No plastic bags inside the bin
daegu-buk.bags: Designated pay-as-you-throw bag shops such as nearby supermarkets and convenience stores
daegu-buk.bulky: Apply and pay 3 days before on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app or www.yeogiro24.co.kr, or buy a sticker, attach it, and report to Seongchang Energy (㈜성창에너지) ☎954-8853~4
daegu-buk.recyclingNotes: Briquette ash: in a clear plastic bag in front of your gate. Small appliances: free collection box for old appliances at the community center (동 주민센터)

daegu-suseong.name: Suseong-gu
daegu-suseong.hours: 20:00–02:00 next day (on your dong's disposal days)
daegu-suseong.days: Pay-as-you-throw bags: put out Sun–Fri evening (pickup Mon–Sat). Food waste, recycling and large waste: days differ by dong (e.g. food waste: Beomeo 1·4-dong etc. Tue·Thu·Sun; Jung-dong, Pa-dong etc. Mon·Wed·Fri)
daegu-suseong.place: In front of your own home or shop (apartments: bins set by the management office)
daegu-suseong.food: Reduce the water as much as possible, put it in the special bin, and attach a payment sticker (납부필증)
daegu-suseong.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops (food-waste and large-waste stickers are sold at the same place)
daegu-suseong.bulky: Apply and pay via 'Large waste application' (대형폐기물 신청) on the Suseong-gu website or the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app, or attach a payment sticker and call the collection company ☎666-2744
daegu-suseong.recyclingNotes: Recycling in net bags: plastic film and clear PET bottles in the red net bag, everything else in the green net bag. Used fluorescent lamps and batteries: special collection boxes

gwangju-buk.name: Buk-gu
gwangju-buk.hours: 20:00 the day before pickup – 05:00 on pickup day
gwangju-buk.place: In front of your own home or shop. Apartments: collection area in the complex
gwangju-buk.food: Special collection bin with a payment sticker (납부필증, bought at bag shops), in front of your door. Not collected if put in a pay-as-you-throw bag. Bones, hard shells and seeds go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투)
gwangju-buk.bulky: Call the contractor Noksaek Hwangyeong (㈜녹색환경, 062-572-1336~7) or report on the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app or website (yeogiro24.co.kr), then put it out. Pickup Mon–Fri
gwangju-buk.recyclingNotes: Recycling in clear bags (white or blue), sorted by item, in front of your door. Used batteries, fluorescent lamps and small appliances: collection boxes at the community center (동 행정복지센터) or apartment

gwangju-seo.name: Seo-gu
gwangju-seo.hours: 20:00 the day before pickup – 06:00 on pickup day
gwangju-seo.days: Differs by area (ask Seo-gu Facilities Management Corporation 서구시설관리공단, 062-374-9446, or see the pickup routes on the district website)
gwangju-seo.place: Door-to-door (in front of your home or business)
gwangju-seo.food: Special collection bin with a payment sticker (납부필증) matching its size, in front of your home from 20:00 the day before to 06:00 on pickup day. Squeeze out the water. Bones, hard shells and tea bags go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투)
gwangju-seo.bags: Nearby shops selling pay-as-you-throw bags and payment stickers (supermarkets etc.)
gwangju-seo.bulky: Report to Seo-gu Facilities Management Corporation (062-374-9446) via the 'Hanson' (한손) app or website, then put it out. No same-day pickup (takes 4–7 days)
gwangju-seo.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a clear bag (black or other non-see-through bags may not be collected). Blankets and cushions: report as large waste

jb-jeonju.name: Jeonju-si
jb-jeonju.hours: 18:00 the day before pickup – 06:00 on pickup day
jb-jeonju.place: A spot in apartment, shop or house areas where waste is easy to put out and collect
jb-jeonju.food: Remove water and foreign objects, and put it in the special collection bin (electronic chip). The fee is added to your water bill. Bones, shellfish shells, eggshells and nut shells are not food waste
jb-jeonju.bulky: Apply and pay on the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app or website (bbegi.com) and attach the reservation number, or report to the district office (Wansan 063-220-5305, Deokjin 063-270-6374)
jb-jeonju.recyclingNotes: Bags for burning: white. Bags for landfill: light green. Shellfish shells etc.: landfill sack (매립용 마대)

jb-gunsan.name: Gunsan-si
jb-gunsan.days: Put out Mon–Fri. On Sunday, after 18:00
jb-gunsan.noPickupDay: No disposal on Saturday, no disposal in the daytime (no pickup on Sunday)
jb-gunsan.place: In front of your own home or at a designated spot
jb-gunsan.food: Drain the water; special collection bin with a payment chip (납부칩) (the day before pickup, 19:00–midnight). Mon·Wed·Fri or Sun·Tue·Thu depending on the neighborhood
jb-gunsan.bags: Designated pay-as-you-throw bag shops (they also sell payment chips)
jb-gunsan.bulky: Buy a waste sticker at a pay-as-you-throw bag shop, attach it, and call the collection company (dong areas 445-2943, eup/myeon 454-7905), or use the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app (bbegi.com)
jb-gunsan.recyclingNotes: Recycling sorted by item in clear plastic bags; mixed with general waste, it counts as general waste. Waste not in a pay-as-you-throw bag (or sack) is not collected

jn-mokpo.name: Mokpo-si
jn-mokpo.hours: Summer 19:00 – before 05:00 next day, winter 18:00 – before 05:00 next day
jn-mokpo.days: Pickup: Mon–Sat morning (no pickup on Sunday)
jn-mokpo.noPickupDay: No disposal from after Saturday's pickup until Sunday afternoon
jn-mokpo.place: Apartments: roll-off container (암롤박스) or designated spot in the complex / Houses: nearby disposal spot set by the dong
jn-mokpo.food: Attach a payment sticker (납부필증) for the bin size to the handle of the special bin; in front of your home or shop (21:00 the day before – 05:00 on pickup day). Houses: every other day by area (Mon·Wed·Fri or Tue·Thu·Sat)
jn-mokpo.bags: Designated shops selling pay-as-you-throw bags, such as supermarkets and convenience stores
jn-mokpo.bulky: Report online via the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app or website, or visit the community center (동 행정복지센터) to get a payment certificate (납부필증), then attach it
jn-mokpo.recyclingNotes: Breaking disposal times or mixing in food waste: fine (과태료) of 100,000 won. Bones, shells and eggshells go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투)

gn-changwon.name: Changwon-si
gn-changwon.hours: 20:00–24:00 the day before pickup (no disposal in the daytime)
gn-changwon.days: Recycling pickup days differ by area (see the table on the city website)
gn-changwon.place: Apartments: designated spot in the complex / Houses: in front of your own gate or a place where it can be collected
gn-changwon.food: Use the special food-waste collection bin. Drain as much water as possible and do not mix in general waste
gn-changwon.bulky: Report online or use the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app (take a photo → choose a date → pay → attach the number). You can also call the contractor for your area
gn-changwon.recyclingNotes: Tie recycling in clear bags (plastic film separately). Non-burnable waste: PP sack for non-burnables (불연재 PP마대)

gn-gimhae.name: Gimhae-si
gn-gimhae.days: Burnable waste: pickup on weekdays Mon–Fri / Non-burnable waste: put out Thursday night, pickup Friday
gn-gimhae.noPickupDay: No pickup on Saturday and Sunday, so do not put waste out
gn-gimhae.place: Dong and eup/myeon centers: in front of your own home / Villages in eup/myeon: designated spot / Apartments: designated collection bin area
gn-gimhae.food: Special collection bin with a band sticker (밴드스티커), in front of your door (Sun–Thu after 20:00; not Fri or Sat evening). RFID apartments: use the machine
gn-gimhae.bulky: Use the 'Bbegi' (빼기) app or website (bbegi.com), or report to the local contractor and pay the fee
gn-gimhae.recyclingNotes: Burnable waste: green pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투). Broken bottles, ceramics etc.: special PP sack (PP포대)

gb-gumi.name: Gumi-si
gb-gumi.days: General (burnable) waste: every day / Briquette ash: Mon·Thu / Non-burnable, recycling, large waste: the day before your area's pickup day
gb-gumi.noPickupDay: No disposal on the day before Seollal, Chuseok and Workers' Day. Recycling and large waste are not collected on Sundays and public holidays
gb-gumi.place: In front of your own building (home or shop). Apartments and multi-family houses: shared collection spot (where trucks can enter)
gb-gumi.food: Apartments with 60+ households: RFID scale. Houses and small restaurants: special bin + payment sticker (납부필증), every other day (18:00–24:00 on disposal day)
gb-gumi.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag shops in the city (supermarkets, convenience stores, large marts etc.)
gb-gumi.bulky: Apply online at 'Bbegi' (빼기, bbegi.com) or attach a large-waste sticker, and put it out 19:00–24:00 the day before your area's pickup day
gb-gumi.recyclingNotes: Non-burnable waste: non-burnable sack (불연성 마대). Illegal dumping: fine (과태료) of up to 1,000,000 won

gb-pohang.name: Pohang-si
gb-pohang.hours: From sunset the day before pickup until 06:00 on pickup day
gb-pohang.days: General waste pickup: Mon·Tue·Thu·Fri / Recycling: Wed·Sat / Non-burnable waste: put out after sunset on Friday (pickup Saturday). Apartments: pickup every day (except Sunday)
gb-pohang.place: In principle, in front of your own home (door-to-door)
gb-pohang.food: Special bin with a sticker band (스티커밴드). Pickup: Nam-gu Mon·Wed·Fri, Buk-gu Tue·Thu·Sat (apartments with scales are different)
gb-pohang.bulky: Attach a large-waste sticker (or an online payment certificate 납부필증) and put it out. Call the Resource Circulation Division (자원순환과) 054-270-4845 or apply online (pohang.go.kr/phrecycle)
gb-pohang.recyclingNotes: Recycling in a clear plastic bag. Broken glass, ceramics, bones and shells: special non-burnable sack (불연성 전용 마대)

gw-wonju.name: Wonju-si
gw-wonju.hours: From sunset the day before pickup until 06:00 on pickup day
gw-wonju.days: Recycling (dong areas etc.): Mon·Thu paper, paper cartons, styrofoam; Tue·Fri PET, plastic, cans, scrap metal, bottles, plastic film / Other eup/myeon: everything on Wed·Sat
gw-wonju.noPickupDay: No disposal during the daytime on weekdays, or from Saturday 06:00 until sunset on Sunday
gw-wonju.place: In front of your own home or shop
gw-wonju.food: Remove foreign objects and water; put it in a special bag or a special collection bin (machine). Rinse salty food, cut large fruits and vegetables into small pieces
gw-wonju.bulky: Apply and pay through the contractor (1800-9614) or the large household waste website (wonju.go.kr/bigclean), attach the payment certificate (납부필증), and put it out
gw-wonju.recyclingNotes: Recycling in clear plastic bags, by day and by item; only the listed items. Broken bottles and ceramics: special PP sack (특수 PP마대)

gw-chuncheon.name: Chuncheon-si
gw-chuncheon.noPickupDay: No disposal on Saturday or the day before a public holiday
gw-chuncheon.place: General waste: nearest collection point / Food waste: apartment shared collection area; houses and shops in front of your own home or shop
gw-chuncheon.food: Houses and shops: special bin, door-to-door (every day 18:00–23:00, except Saturday). Apartments: food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제봉투) or RFID
gw-chuncheon.bulky: Report on the Chuncheon large waste website (clean.chuncheon.go.kr), then put it at the designated spot
gw-chuncheon.recyclingNotes: For burning (burnable waste): orange bag. For landfill (porcelain dishes, broken glass, bones, shells): sky-blue bag

gg-goyang.name: Goyang-si
gg-goyang.days: Pickup every day, no pickup on Sunday (same in Deogyang-gu, Ilsandong-gu, Ilsanseo-gu; each area's contractor collects 05:00–11:00)
gg-goyang.place: In front of your own door. Apartments: the spot set by the complex
gg-goyang.food: Houses: put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투) or in a special bin (3·5·20L) with a payment sticker (납부필증) attached, on the roadside in front of your home on pickup day. Apartments: 120L shared bin or RFID scale bin
gg-goyang.bags: Official pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) shops (supermarkets, shops, etc.)
gg-goyang.bulky: Online: pay at the Goyang bulky waste online report center (clean.gys.or.kr) and attach the receipt (필증) / App '빼기' (Ppaegi) / Buy a sticker at a shop, attach it and call your area's contractor
gg-goyang.recyclingNotes: Recyclables in a clear bag. Clear PET bottles: remove the label, crush, close the cap and put in a clear bag. Non-burnable waste like glass and ceramics: in Goyang's non-burnable sack (불연성 마대)

gg-bucheon.name: Bucheon-si
gg-bucheon.days: General and food waste: every day except Saturday and the day before a public holiday. Recyclables: Mon·Wed·Fri or Tue·Thu·Sat depending on your dong (check the recycling pickup day table on the city website)
gg-bucheon.noPickupDay: Do not put it out on Saturday or the day before a public holiday (no pickup on Sunday and public holidays)
gg-bucheon.place: Houses: in front of your own gate or a spot where pickup is possible / Apartments: the spot set by the complex
gg-bucheon.food: Put it in a food-waste bag (sold at pay-as-you-throw bag shops) and put the whole bag in the collection bin. Drain the water. Putting it in a general bag means a fine
gg-bucheon.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) shops (see 'designated shop locations' on the city website)
gg-bucheon.bulky: Report and pay at clean.bucheon.go.kr, attach the receipt (필증) and put it out / Phone 032-320-3000 / Visit the community center (행정복지센터). Put it out at ground level
gg-bucheon.recyclingNotes: Recyclables in a recycling net bag or clear plastic bag. Tie boxes, newspapers and styrofoam with string. Net bags are free at the dong community center (행정복지센터)

gg-anyang.name: Anyang-si
gg-anyang.days: Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu (based on dong community center notices in Manan-gu and Dongan-gu)
gg-anyang.noPickupDay: Friday and Saturday (no pickup on Saturday and Sunday)
gg-anyang.place: Houses: in front of your own home (or shop) / Apartments: the spot set by the complex
gg-anyang.food: Remove water and foreign objects, then put it in a food-waste bag or a special food-waste bin. Bones, shells, seeds, etc. are general waste
gg-anyang.bulky: Apply online at '대형폐기물배출신고' (bulky waste report) on the city website (anyang.go.kr), attach the payment receipt (납부필증) and put it out, or attach a sticker. Pickup Tue–Fri
gg-anyang.recyclingNotes: Recyclables by type in clear plastic bags. Pottery, glass and ceramics in a non-burnable bag (PP sack)

gg-namyangju.name: Namyangju-si
gg-namyangju.days: Pickup days differ by area. Ask the local pickup company written on the bag. No pickup on Sunday
gg-namyangju.place: In front of your own home or shop building / Apartments: the shared disposal spot
gg-namyangju.food: Remove water and foreign objects, then put it in a special food-waste bin or a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투)
gg-namyangju.bulky: Report online at smartclean.nyj.go.kr (bulky waste center), or buy a report receipt (신고필증) at the eup/myeon/dong community center (행정복지센터) and attach it. Inquiries: 1588-4077
gg-namyangju.recyclingNotes: Plastic, cans and bottles each in a clear plastic bag. Clear PET bottles separately. Broken glass and ceramic dishes in a standard sack (규격마대)

gg-gwangmyeong.name: Gwangmyeong-si
gg-gwangmyeong.days: Pickup every day (except Sunday and public holidays). Food waste: put it out Sun–Fri after 20:00
gg-gwangmyeong.place: In front of your own gate
gg-gwangmyeong.food: Squeeze out the water, put it in the yellow food-waste bag, then in the disposal bin. Bones, shells and fruit seeds are general waste
gg-gwangmyeong.bulky: Report on the app '지구하다' (Zguhada) or at gwangmyeong-gyeonggi.hwm.zguhada.com / Phone 1866-0201 / Attach a sticker from a designated shop
gg-gwangmyeong.recyclingNotes: Paper, bottles, metal, plastic, styrofoam, etc.: sort by type, tie with string or put in clear bags, in front of your gate

gg-hanam.name: Hanam-si
gg-hanam.place: In front of your home or shop / Apartments etc.: the designated spot
gg-hanam.food: Houses: remove water and foreign objects, put it in a special food-waste bin with a payment chip (납부필증) / Apartments: shared food-waste bin
gg-hanam.bulky: Buy a sticker, attach it and put it out. For reporting and fees, ask your area's contractor (company list on the city website)
gg-hanam.recyclingNotes: Houses: sort by item into clear plastic bags, in front of your home. Apartment plastic film and styrofoam: collected directly by the city (031-790-6251)

gg-paju.name: Paju-si
gg-paju.days: Houses: Mon–Sat, differs by alley (check with the pickup company). No pickup on Sunday and public holidays. Apartments follow their complex
gg-paju.noPickupDay: No pickup on Sunday and public holidays
gg-paju.place: On the main road in front of your home. Unjeong New Town districts 1 and 2: put it directly into the automatic collection system inlet
gg-paju.food: In the yellow food-waste bag. Apartments with an RFID scale: no bag, weigh it and dispose
gg-paju.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) shops such as supermarkets and convenience stores
gg-paju.bulky: Pay on the app/web '빼기' (Ppaegi) or '그린원' (Green One), attach the application number and put it out, or buy a sticker at a shop
gg-paju.recyclingNotes: Sort recyclables by item into clear plastic bags. Pottery, broken glass and tiles in a non-burnable waste bag
